description: This is a shell script used for testing Git's reference name format checking functionality. It defines test cases for the 'git check-ref-format' command, including valid and invalid reference names under various options and scenarios.

methods.name: valid_ref
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting 'git check-ref-format' to succeed for the given reference name with optional parameters.

methods.name: invalid_ref
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting 'git check-ref-format' to fail for the given reference name with optional parameters.

methods.name: valid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Defines a test case to verify that 'git check-ref-format --normalize' simplifies the reference name correctly.

methods.name: invalid_ref_normalized
methods.description: Defines a test case to verify that 'git check-ref-format --normalize' rejects invalid reference names.

search-terms: shell script test for git refs
